name: The Olive Table
subtitle: Answers, day or night
greeting: Hello! Ask me anything about The Olive Table. I'll only tell you things the team has actually confirmed.

answers.a:
We're open Tuesday to Thursday 5pm to 10pm, Friday and Saturday 12pm to 11pm, and Sunday 12pm to 8pm.

We're closed on Mondays.

Yes. We have a separate vegan menu with five mains, and most of our starters are vegetarian.

If you have a specific allergy, please tell your server when you arrive so the kitchen can check the dish for you properly.

q: do you have a car park
answers.a: There's free street parking on Mill Lane after 6pm, and a pay and display car park about two minutes' walk away on Bridge Street.

Yes, we take bookings. For groups up to 8 you can book online or give us a ring.

For 9 or more, please call us so we can sort the seating properly.
Dogs are very welcome in the bar area and outside on the terrace. We just ask that they're not in the main dining room.

q: do you have a kids menu
answers.a: Children are welcome. We have a kids' menu, high chairs, and a baby changing table in the accessible toilet.

order.title: Order for collection
order.subtitle: Tap what you'd like
order.note: You'll send this from your own phone. Nothing is paid here, and The Olive Table will text you back to confirm.

pageSub: Questions answered, and order for collection.
